about.title: Southside Park, Sacramento, California
about.extract: Southside Park is a neighborhood in Sacramento, California, located immediately south of Downtown Sacramento. Its official borders are R Street to the north, W-X Freeway to the south, I-5 to the west, and 12th Street to the east.

stocking.note: CDFW publishes the week and species, not counts. History grows each night from the public schedule.
